name: cad-3d-printing
description: CAD and 3D Printing: geometry representations and kernels, file formats and what each one loses, code-CAD and scripting including the OpenSCAD versus OCCT trade, mesh processing and repair, the slicing pipeline and G-code, the additive processes and the physics that determines part quality, design for additive manufacturing, tolerances and fits, materials, generative design and lattices, automation pipelines, and scanning and reverse engineering.
